summary: Delete-flow bug (iteration 17) verified fixed. Tested on web preview (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1280x800) via Playwright with real login (test@copythat.app / 246810). All 5 critical scenarios passed: (1) delete doc from doc screen navigates back to /archive and the deleted document is removed from the list immediately without reload (useFocusEffect reload works); (2) rapid double-tap on doc-delete does NOT produce an uncaught 'Hittades inte' error — guarded by `deleting` state + 404 swallowed as success in deleteDoc; (3) deleting an already-deleted document (simulated via direct API DELETE before clicking the trash) is handled gracefully (404 treated as success, navigates back cleanly, no uncaught errors); (4) course delete via delete-course removes the course from the sidebar list immediately; (5) desktop wide layout (sidebar+doc list side-by-side) deletes doc and the list on the right updates without reload. Note: page-delete-N could not be functionally tested because pages require OCR which fails without AI keys (see test_credentials.md note); code for deletePage uses the same optimistic-UI + 404-swallow pattern and reviewed as correct.
critical_code_review_comments: deleteDoc in /app/frontend/app/doc/[id].tsx:126-147 correctly guards double-tap with `deleting` state, swallows 404 as success, sets mounted.current=false before navigating, falls back to router.replace('/archive') if canGoBack is false — all good.
archive.tsx uses useFocusEffect to reload courses + current course docs on return, so delete-elsewhere flows reflect immediately. selectedRef pattern avoids stale closure. Good.
deletePage in /app/frontend/app/doc/[id].tsx:161-171 does optimistic UI removal first, then DELETE, then load() — swallows 404. Correct pattern.
delete-course handler in archive.tsx:217-227 does optimistic state removal, swallows 404, then reloads. Correct.

Minor: deletePage calls load() after the DELETE which is redundant with the optimistic update when request succeeds (extra GET), but it is useful for correcting state if deletion partially failed. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created a few test courses (names prefixed with DT/ST/W + timestamp) and documents for the delete tests. Documents were deleted as part of the tests. Some empty test courses may remain in the user's archive (DT1792364013, DT1792364184).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: POST /api/auth/request-code {email:'test@copythat.app'} then /api/auth/verify {email, code:'246810'} → localStorage['copythat.token']=JSON.stringify(token). To test window.confirm flows, override `window.confirm = () => true;` BEFORE every delete action (reset after any navigation). doc-delete, delete-course, page-delete-N testIDs are stable. The archive uses useFocusEffect so no reload is needed after returning from a delete. deletePage was not UI-tested because pages require OCR which errors without AI keys.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Delete function is bad, you must restart the app to see that it is deleted' + iOS 'Uncaught (in promise) Error: Hittades inte' with double DELETE (200+404). Root causes addressed in code: (a) archive did not refresh on focus → fixed with useFocusEffect reloading courses+docs; (b) rapid double-tap sent two DELETE requests, the second returning 404 which bubbled up as uncaught rejection → fixed with `deleting` state guard on the button + explicit `if (e.status !== 404) throw/flash; else treat as success` in deleteDoc/deletePage/delete-course. All three delete flows now follow the same pattern. Verified via Playwright that: (i) no 'Hittades inte' errors occur on double-tap; (ii) stale-delete (doc already gone) exits cleanly to /archive; (iii) list refreshes without a manual reload.
